Remove the window spend cap.
Remove the count cap, so a retry storm under the value cap passes.
MAKE THE EXIT REFUSABLE — mayExit returns false. The invariant the brief names.
GATE THE EXIT BEHIND THE DRAWDOWN HALT — a halted stray can no longer sell.
Evaluate ENTRY before EXIT, so risk gates get a chance to run first.
Count the window from the SAMPLE COUNT, not the clock — openhood's 12x units bug.

Remove the long-only guard, so a crash is treated as an entry signal.
Remove the take-profit cost floor, so a target that cannot pay for its exit is allowed.
